name: DOADW 9-Tier Metal Shoe Rack Organizer - Holds 35-40 Pairs of Shoes & Boots
description: Selling a heavy-duty DOADW 9-Tier Metal Shoe Rack Organizer [Amazon](https://amazon.com). This massive, space-saving shoe tower features a double-row design capable of neatly storing 35-40 pairs of shoes, sneakers, flats, and tall boots. Built with thickened metal tubes, durable plastic connectors, and waterproof PP sheets for premium stability. The custom DIY modular structure allows you to split it into two separate racks (e.g., a 4-tier and a 5-tier) or remove panels to comfortably fit high-top winter boots. Includes two sets of side hooks for hanging keys, bags, or pet leashes. The rack is fully pre-assembled, saving you from a frustrating 30-minute construction setup involving small joints and hammers. Please note: This comes from a pet-friendly apartment with a cat. The entire rack has been thoroughly dusted, vacuumed, and wiped clean, though minor pet dust particles might remain due to plastic static. Does NOT come with secondary retail storage packaging or bags; local pickup buyers, please bring a large vehicle space or transport support.
contact_note: Fully pre-assembled giant storage unit—zero assembly required. Because it is tall and pre-assembled, please make sure your vehicle backseat can be folded flat or bring an SUV/truck for smooth transport. From a cat-friendly apartment.
meta_description: Pre-assembled DOADW 9-Tier Metal Shoe Rack for sale. Holds 35-40 pairs of shoes and boots. Double-row black modular design, fully cleaned, good condition.
name_zh: DOADW 9层加厚金属大容量鞋架 / 双排模块化拼装置物架 (可放35-40双鞋)
description_zh: 低价转让一个超大容量的 DOADW 9层双排金属组装鞋架（官方型号：RACK-9Tier-Black）[Amazon](https://amazon.com)。由加厚防锈金属管、韧性塑料接头以及防水防尘 PP 隔板组合而成，稳固耐重，最多可整齐收纳 35-40 双各式球鞋、单鞋和高帮靴。采用自由 DIY 模块化结构，可以根据空间拆开组装成两个独立的矮鞋架，或自由拆卸单层来为长筒靴预留高度；侧边还自带两组挂钩用来悬挂钥匙、背包或雨伞。目前鞋架已完全整体组装完毕，为您彻底免去了原厂需要自己用锤子敲敲打打拼装30多分钟、极度繁琐的劳动过程。**诚实披露**：家里养猫，属于宠物友好型环境。出货前整个鞋架已用吸尘器进行了深度除尘并用抹布进行了全面去污擦拭，但由于塑料隔板材质带有静电，可能还会吸附极微量游离猫毛残余。本家居用品不附带原厂二次包装大袋子，本地自提的买家朋友请开 SUV 或后排能放倒的轿车来载，方便直接整架抬走。
